Markus / Naomi —

Operational plan for RQ-ALDER-572:
1) Identification: We need the conversation UUID from Acme (please paste). Once received we will run a server-side lookup across the primary index and any active telemetry joins.
2) Isolation: Create a scoped deletion job that removes the conversation document from the search index and marks any KV-cache entries for expiry. This job does NOT touch model training datasets; it targets operational logs, monitoring telemetry, and our internal query indices.
3) Replicas/backups: For hosted customers, we maintain rolling snapshots for disaster recovery. Scoped deletions will also flag those snapshots (metadata) as containing the removed object; full purge from cold backups requires a longer window (we estimate up to 30 days for physical expunge from immutable backup stores depending on retention policy and legal hold). We will provide a timeline and a statement about backups.
4) Evidence: After the job runs we will generate an audit extract (CSV) listing the removed object and the job id. I have attached a stub audit extract for formatting (audit_extract_20270614_stub.csv).

ETA: If Acme gives the conversation UUID and confirms authorization by EOD Jun 15, we can schedule the deletion for Jun 16 (non-peak window). Final purge from backups — see above — is longer and we'll provide a statement.

Internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RQ-ALDER-572 (internal)
